title: Данкугар: Да благословит господь
originalTitle: Choujuu Kishin Dancougar: God Bless Dancougar
alt: Chouju Kishin Dancouga: God Bless Dancouga / Chôjû kishin Dancouga: God Bless Dancouga God Bless Dancougar 超獣機神ダンクーガ ゴッド・ブレス・ダンクーガ
description: After destroying the Zorbados Empire, the Jyusenki-tai/Cyber Beast Force has expanded and are training new recruits. But after failing to stop a monster that seems to be a remnant of the Zorbados Empire from destroying a city, the CBF is thrown in jail. Now the CBF have to escape from jail and find out what was behind the monster they fought. (Source: Anime News Network)

en:
After destroying the Zorbados Empire, the Jyusenki-tai/Cyber Beast Force has expanded and are training new recruits. But after failing to stop a monster that seems to be a remnant of the Zorbados Empire from destroying a city, the CBF is thrown in jail. Now the CBF have to escape from jail and find out what was behind the monster they fought.



(Source: Anime News Network)
ja: 超獣機神ダンクーガ ゴッド・ブレス・ダンクーガ
